verdict.rationale: Moosend is an email marketing SaaS, so versioned APIs with a deprecation policy are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions API versioning or a deprecation policy; it covers only pricing, templates, automation and no-code integrations. The community posts concern ending the free plan, not API deprecation, so they are off-topic and ignored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
